subject: Your FF Digest

disagreements.detail: High expert disagreement: rank 6-20 (std 3.06) -- highest: Mike Harmon (#5), lowest: Nathan Jahnke (#21)

news.title: Jon Gaines II (ankle) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Gaines was unable to practice all week due to an ankle injury.

news.title: Hjalte Froholdt (concussion) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Froholdt will be sidelined as he remains in concussion protocol.

news.title: George Pickens (hamstring) practices Friday
news.impact: Pickens remained limited in practice on Thursday. He is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

news.title: Javon Bullard (ankle/knee) back at practice Friday
news.impact: Bullard will have a chance to play on Sunday against the Vikings with his return to practice.

news.title: Lukas Van Ness (back) returns to practice Friday
news.impact: Van Ness will have a chance to play on Sunday against the Vikings with his return to practice.

narrative: Quiet week on the movement front — just one name really splitting the room. Dak Prescott is the lone flashpoint, with experts pegging him anywhere from QB6 to QB20. Mike Harmon is all the way in at #5, while Nathan Jahnke has him buried at #21. That's a 3.06 standard deviation, which is analyst-speak for "nobody has any idea." Trust your own read on this one, because the pros sure aren't helping.
